content_sections.heading: How to Attend KAU Technician Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Ensure you meet the required ITI qualification and age criteria. Prepare original certificates supporting your educational qualification, age, work experience, and identity proof. Carry self-attested copies of all required certificates. Report for the walk-in interview on 13 October 2026 at 10:00 AM. Attend the interview venue at Kelappaji College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology, Tavanur, Malappuram, Kerala.
